title: secretx: URI bypasses base64 validation in Config::validate correctly
description: smtp/config.rs and reader/config.rs both skip the base64/length check for dkim.key_seed_b64 when the value starts with 'secretx:'. This is correct: Config::validate() runs before secretx resolution, so the bytes are not yet available. A future contributor might add a 'validate the secretx URI syntax here too' check — that would be wrong because it would create a tight coupling between the config format and the secretx URI scheme. The skip is intentional and the test test_dkim_config_secretx_seed_skips_validation explicitly covers this invariant.
